title: Security fix for GHSA-6v7p-g79w-8964 applied in: miniforge3 25.11.0.1-r6
description: A high-severity security vulnerability affecting the miniforge3 package was identified and fixed in version 25.11.0.1-r6. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but causes a significant availability impact. The issue is resolved in the fixed release 25.11.0.1-r6.
